canonical_project: Gujarat State Data Centre - Rajkot mini/colocation node
notes: Government state-data-centre node. Academic paper (IJCSEITR, Dec 2019) states GSDC provides mini/colocation data centre at Rajkot (also Surat, Vadodara, Mahesana); GIL/GSDC page confirms GSDC program but not the Rajkot node. No commercial colo evidence found for Rajkot district. Capacity not disclosed.
